name: How to Get Mythic Heroes in War Inc: Rising — Complete Summoning Guide
title: How to Get Mythic Heroes in War Inc: Rising — Wheel, Card Master and Summon Strategy | War Inc: Rising Wiki
meta_description: Complete guide to getting Mythic heroes in War Inc: Rising. Learn Wheel vs Card Master math, summon event strategy, mythic priority ranking, gem spending efficiency, and recruitment tips.
author: War Inc Wiki Team
excerpt: Mythic heroes are the most powerful units in War Inc: Rising. This guide covers every method to acquire them — the Wheel, Card Master, summon events, recruitment, and the Exchange Shop — plus which mythics to prioritize and how many gems each method costs.

sections.heading: What Are Mythic Heroes?
sections.content:
Mythic heroes are the highest rarity in War Inc: Rising. They have the best base stats, the strongest skills, and dominating combat power. Building a roster of Mythic heroes is essential for competing at the highest levels of Arena, Clan War, and all PvE modes.

There are currently 34 Mythic heroes in the game. The top tier includes Light Seeker, Frost Queen, Radiant Warrior, Bone Marksman, Necromancer, and Mistral Archer. New mythics are added regularly through seasonal events like the Light vs Dark update.

Acquiring and leveling Mythic heroes is the primary long-term goal in War Inc: Rising. A level 4 Mythic can cost anywhere from 9,000 to 13,000 gems depending on the method and your luck.

sections.heading: Method 1: The Wheel (Best Value)
sections.content:
The Wheel is the most efficient way to acquire Mythic heroes. Each spin costs gems, and you get guaranteed mythic rewards at milestone chests.

Pull rates: roughly 4% per spin for a mythic (about 1 in 25 spins). The rest are legendary, epic, rare, and coins.

The key to efficiency is stopping at milestone chests. The recommended stop points are 10 pulls (first chest), 30 pulls (second chest), 50 pulls (significant reward), and 100 pulls (guaranteed mythic).

Average cost for a level 4 mythic via the Wheel: roughly 11,000 gems with average luck, budget 13,000 for safety. Only spin wheels that feature the mythic troop you actually need. Never spin non-mythic wheels.

sections.heading: Method 2: Card Master (Comparable Value)
sections.content:
Card Master is the secondary method for acquiring mythics. It costs roughly 250 gems per pull. Each draw gives a random card from a pool of 12, and you draw without replacement. One of the 12 cards is the featured mythic.

On average it takes 6.5 picks to get the specific mythic you want. To take a mythic to level 6 you need 32 copies, which translates to roughly 208 total picks at 250 gems each.

The raw cost looks high but chest rewards every 10 pulls reduce the effective price significantly. When factoring in chest rewards, Card Master is comparable to the Wheel in cost efficiency.

Use Card Master when the featured mythic rotation includes troops you need. It is not a trap — it is a legitimate alternative to the Wheel.

sections.heading: Method 3: Summon Events
sections.content:
Summon events run periodically with boosted rates for specific mythics. These events are the best time to spend your saved scrolls.

The optimal strategy is to spend roughly 30 scrolls per grouping. The first 10 scrolls get you a chest, and the next 20 get you forge stones. This gives you the best reward-per-scroll ratio.

Best targets for summon events: Starlight Apostle, Night King, and Geomancer. These are the most valuable mythics to chase during events.

Save your scrolls between events. Do not spend them on permanent summon unless you have a specific need. Event banners offer better rates and additional rewards.

sections.heading: Method 4: Recruitment and Mastery
sections.content:
Recruitment is a secondary source of mythics. Level 1 recruitment gives mastery points that fill progress bars toward mastery chests. Level 3 recruitment gives more epics per gem and gold.

Balance between level 1 and level 3 recruitment. If you only do level 3, you miss out on mastery points. If you only do level 1, you get fewer epics. A good rule: use level 1 when you need mastery points, level 3 when you need more epics.

Stay near the gold cap but do not waste natural regeneration. When you are near the cap, spend gold on recruitment to avoid wasting the natural income.

Mastery chests give random rewards including mythic shards. It is a slow method but every bit helps.

sections.heading: Mythic Priority — Which to Target First
sections.content:
Based on the current meta, here is the order you should pursue mythic acquisition.

1. Radiant Warrior — S+ tier. Frontline survival is critical in every mode.
2. Bone Marksman — Best unit in the game. Useful in all modes.
3. Necromancer — Skeletons reinforce frontline and disrupt enemies.
4. Woodland Guardian — Good in all modes with self-healing.
5. Light Seeker — Needs level 4 to shine. Skip if you cannot get there.
6. Frost Queen — Excellent for backstabs and outflanks.
7. Mist Archer — Only go for if you have the top 6.
8. Darkmoon Queen — Good for mid-level players.
9. Red Blade — Falls off hard after mid-game.

Cost reference: A level 4 mythic costs roughly 11,000 gems on the Wheel or 9,000 gems on Card Master.

sections.heading: Alternative Sources: Exchange Shop and Events
sections.content:
The Exchange Shop (Caravan Camp) occasionally features mythic troops. Complete 12 tasks per week for 6,000 coins. Best buys in order: all 10 Royal Archers (4,000 coins), Gem Scrolls (1,500), then single scrolls.

Dragon Clash events have separate quest logs and reward trees. Pick a side immediately when the event starts. Missing even one day wastes valuable rewards.

Daily sign-in rewards sometimes include mythic shards. Do not miss these. Set a daily reminder if needed.

Seasonal events like the Light vs Dark season introduce new mythics. These limited-time mythics are only available during their event window. Plan your gem savings around these releases.

mainEntity.name: How do I get Mythic heroes in War Inc: Rising?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main methods are the Wheel (best value, stop at milestone chests), Card Master (comparable value), summon events (best for specific mythics), and recruitment (slow but consistent).

mainEntity.name: How many gems does a level 4 mythic cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roughly 11,000 gems on the Wheel (budget 13,000) or 9,000 gems on Card Master (budget 12,000).

mainEntity.name: Which mythic should I get first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Radiant Warrior is the top priority, followed by Bone Marksman and Necromancer. These three form the core of most top-tier formations.

mainEntity.name: Is the Wheel or Card Master better for mythics?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Wheel is slightly better when you stop at milestone chests (10, 30, 50, 100 pulls). Card Master is comparable when factoring chest rewards. Use both depending on available rotations.

mainEntity.name: Can I get mythics from the Exchange Shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Exchange Shop features mythic-adjacent troops like Royal Archers. Complete 12 weekly tasks for 6,000 caravan coins. Best buys: all 10 Royal Archers (4,000 coins), then Gem Scrolls.
